configuration.meta_coverage_note: Three preselected cases subject to the existing $1 local estimated-dollar guard. Unattempted cases remain explicitly unmeasured.
configuration.protocol_change: Mandatory deterministic preserve baseline preloaded; compact evidence feedback; final request reserved for selection. Version 1 outcomes are retained as failed-budget evidence.

limitations: Synthetic cases; no factory telemetry or industrial validation.
Meta coverage is a predeclared subset, not all 20 cases.
Fallback results remain labelled and are not successful autonomous decisions.
Wall-clock-bounded CP-SAT schedules can vary across hosts.
distribution_note: Normalized episode artifacts are gzip-compressed for the public repository. No raw provider HTTP responses are included.
